name: image-oom-busy-queue
description: The first round fails with an out-of-memory error while ComfyUI is still running another job: nothing is unloaded and no second round is submitted.

provenance.reference: ComfyUI server routes POST /prompt (a failed validation or run answers a text/JSON error), GET /queue, POST /free {unload_models, free_memory}, GET /history/{prompt_id}, GET /view (ComfyUI server.py)

body.text: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.00 GiB
